title: Web Frameworks and Software Engineering Quiz
description: A 15-question quiz covering MVC, Spring data modelling, UI design, specification by example, testing, REST APIs, and external service integration.

questions.text: In the MVC pattern, what is the main role of the model?
options: To display data to the user
To represent and manage application data
To convert HTTP responses into HTML

questions.text: Which MVC component handles user input and manipulates the model?
Which statements correctly describe a view in MVC?
options: It displays a subset of data to the user
It is basically the user interface
It must directly update the database
Multiple views can exist for the same data

questions.text: In Spring layered architecture, the {word_1} handles database access, while the {word_2} contains business logic.
Match each JPA annotation to its purpose.

options: Marks a class as a table

questions.text: What does Spring Data Repository provide automatically?
options: CRUD operations such as findAll(), findById(), and save()

questions.text: Which are among the Eight Golden Rules of Interface Design from the notes?

options: Design choices that help users make informed decisions
Techniques that trick users into doing something they might not want
A testing method for REST APIs

questions.text: What is specification by example mainly used for?
options: Replacing all unit tests with diagrams

questions.text: A typical example-based specification describes behaviour using {word_1}, action, and expected output.
Which validation-related Spring concepts are mentioned in the notes?
Match each testing term to its meaning.

options: Testing the whole system end to end
Running the code and testing it
Testing based on internal code structure
A test that always fails because of a syntax error
A test that sometimes passes and sometimes fails without code changes
A test that only checks the user interface
A test that is generated by a repository

questions.text: Which statements describe REST according to the notes?
options: Everything is treated as a resource
The server stores all client session state
Requests should contain all needed information in stateless communication

questions.text: Match each external API concept to its description.

options: An individual post with fields such as id, content, URL, datetime, and language
